Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv. 6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are played, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
